name: Inbox/komentar can be created with account and date and deleted
description: Verifies an Inbox or Komentar can store account and date, preserve long text, and be deleted permanently.
steps: Open Engagement and scroll to Inbox/Komentar
Click Tambah, select account Facebook and a date, then select Inbox
Enter a long inbox message and save
Confirm the account and date are shown on the new record
Click the delete button and confirm deletion
Refresh the page
expected: The inbox shows the selected account and date before deletion, then is removed and remains absent after refresh.

name: Komentar preserves long content and content link
description: Verifies a long Komentar entry with a content link remains visible after refresh.
steps: Open Engagement and scroll to Inbox/Komentar
Click Tambah and select Komentar
Choose an account and date
Enter a long comment and add a content link
Save the record
Refresh the page
expected: The full comment text, selected account, date, and content link remain visible after refresh.

name: Inbox/komentar filters by account and date
description: Verifies the Inbox/Komentar data box can filter records by account and date range.
setup: Create one Inbox for Facebook dated 2026-09-10 and one Komentar for TikTok dated 2026-09-20
steps: Open Engagement and scroll to Inbox/Komentar
Set the account filter to Facebook
Set the date range from 2026-09-01 to 2026-09-15
Review the filtered list
Click Reset
expected: Only the Facebook record dated 2026-09-10 is visible while the filters are active, and both records are visible again after Reset.

name: YouTube engagement stores manual monthly views impressions and CTR
description: Verifies YouTube engagement data uses separate monthly storage.
steps: Open Engagement
Choose a month
Confirm a visible horizontal separator appears between the engagement summary cards and account cards
Open the YouTube card
Enter Views, Impression, and CTR impression
Save
Refresh the page
expected: The saved YouTube metrics remain after refresh.

name: Performa iklan saves up to five ad records per account
covers: separator between summary and account cards
description: Verifies entered advertising data is saved for multiple ad slots, optional blank slots are allowed, and account totals persist.
steps: Open Performa Iklan and choose the current month
Confirm the summary cards are labeled with the Iklan prefix and include Iklan follower baru
Open the Facebook account card
Enter values in Iklan 1 and Iklan 3, leaving Iklan 2, 4, and 5 blank
Click Simpan semua data
Confirm the Facebook totals include Iklan 1 and Iklan 3 and the account card does not show Total 5 iklan
Refresh the page and reopen Facebook
expected: The entered ad data is saved, the blank ad slots do not block saving, and the account totals remain after refresh.

name: Followers uses subscribers wording for YouTube
description: Verifies only the displayed wording changes for YouTube.
steps: Open Followers
Review the YouTube card and update form
expected: YouTube uses subscriber wording while the underlying follower values and calculations remain unchanged.

name: Zero follower change is excluded from history
description: Verifies an account with no follower increase or decrease does not create a history entry, and an existing monthly entry is removed when changed to zero.
steps: Open Followers and update one account with Followers baru set to 0 for a selected month
Save the follower update
Open Perubahan follower and review the selected month
Edit the same monthly follower update from a nonzero change to 0 and save
expected: No zero-valued follower change appears in Perubahan follower, and an existing monthly change disappears when it is changed to 0.

name: Overview filters all displayed data to the selected month
description: Verifies Overview uses only records belonging to the selected month across its summary sections.
steps: Open Overview
Choose month 2026-09
Review the Overview KPI cards and monthly sections
Change the month to 2026-10
expected: All Overview values and sections update to use only the selected month, and no prior-to-latest trend is shown.

name: Overview excludes the removed cards and charts
description: Verifies the Overview layout keeps inbox/comment information while omitting the requested total followers, content type, and inbox-vs-comment charts.
steps: Open Overview on a mobile viewport
Review the KPI cards and content sections
Scroll through the Overview
expected: There is no Total Followers KPI, no Jenis Konten chart, and no Inbox vs Komentar chart, while Inbox and Komentar counts and entries remain visible.

name: Existing monthly data remains separate when Overview month changes
description: Verifies switching the Overview month changes the displayed dataset without merging different months into one summary.
steps: Open Overview and choose 2026-09
Note the displayed monthly values
Switch to 2026-10
Switch back to 2026-09
expected: Each selected month shows its own stored data and returning to 2026-09 restores the September-only values.

name: Followers growth compares August against July
description: Verifies the Followers card calculates a selected month's growth from that month's follower snapshot versus the immediately previous month's snapshot.
steps: Open Followers
Enter or confirm a July follower snapshot for an account
Enter or confirm an August follower snapshot for the same account
Select August in the Followers month filter
Review the Followers growth value
expected: August growth equals (August followers minus July followers) divided by July followers, multiplied by 100, and the value is shown when both monthly snapshots exist.
